facts.fact: Internet Society Pulse, from PeeringDB, lists the Windhoek Internet Exchange Point (IXP Namibia) with 6 member networks and 23 Gbps of cumulative port capacity, with one new member joined in the last 12 months.
facts.system: Windhoek Internet Exchange Point - IXP Namibia

facts.fact: Internet Society Pulse, from PeeringDB, lists Paratus Africa, registered in Mauritius, as a member of the Windhoek Internet Exchange Point alongside Namibian members (Packet Clearing House's US-registered networks also appear).
